what: Hysteresis quantisation (web/shaders/hysteresis/): GPU passes against the float64 CPU reference over frame sequences, and the falsification tests
source: fixtures/street.mjs streetScene(320, 200, t) with the lamp flicker, t = f / 24; an orbit case uses motionVectors between consecutive cameras

tests.ramp: lamp intensity scaled from 1 to 2 over 48 frames

rules: No criterion uses a measured display reading or calibrate-pro (author, 2026-10-10).
why: Decisions are discrete. f32 against f64 can flip a decision only where the input sits within rounding of a threshold or a margin edge; hysteresis then carries that flip, so the bound is a fraction of decisions, not zero.
